description:
## Problem
Fetcher.perform_http_request and fetch_single together handle HTTP client creation, header setup, response processing, redirect handling, error mapping, and client lifecycle. This is ~80 lines of HTTP-specific logic inside a class whose primary job is fetch orchestration.

Note: there is already a ticket vugcr-pvr for this extraction. This ticket refines it.

## Proposal
Create `Fetcher::SingleRequest` class that encapsulates one HTTP request cycle:
- Constructor receives config, http_client_factory, image_processor
- `execute(url, uri, initial_dns_ips, redirect_count) : Result`
- Owns: client creation, header construction, response processing, redirect detection, error classification
- Owns: semaphore acquire/release, rate limiting check, DNS revalidation

This leaves Fetcher responsible for:
- URL validation
- Loop management (redirects, gray placeholder retries)
- Cache coordination
- DNS tracking across redirect chains

## Benefits
- Single Responsibility: one HTTP request = one object
- Fetcher drops from ~396 lines to ~200 lines
- HTTP request logic becomes independently testable
title: Extract HTTP request execution from Fetcher into SingleRequest class
